name: blockchain-research
description: Multi-chain blockchain protocol and on-chain data indexing research skill. Make sure to use this skill whenever the user is investigating Ethereum (EVM, EIPs, go-ethereum, reth, revm, prysm), Solana (SVM, SIMDs, PoH, agave, SPL), or Tempo (TIP-20, MPP, Simplex BFT, Payment Lanes, Fee AMM), or when indexing concerns come up (reorg, finality, ABI/IDL, asset standards, RPC, protocol-level transfers, tx envelopes, state access) - even if they just ask 'how does X work' or 'why does Y behave this way' without the word 'research'.
